FlatBuffers uses a date-based version scheme (`YEAR.MONTH.DAY`) in `include/flatbuffers/base.h`, and the minor component tracks the release month. The last value I can recall from training data is `9` (from release v25.9.23), but "current development source" as of today is beyond what I can verify offline, and the project typically cuts several releases per year — so that recollection is likely stale, and I won't present it as the current constant.

ANSWER: unknown
